Subject: Access Passcodes & short trial extension for BrightFoundry roundtable

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for co-hosting the May 18 roundtable with us. A couple of quick ops asks so we can finalize registration follow-ups:

- We can provide a bulk batch of 50 on-demand access passcodes for affiliate registrants (one redemption per code). Attached is a provisional CSV (affiliates-passcodes-v2.csv) with codes we plan to load.
- Can BrightFoundry confirm whether you want a standard 14-day trial or if we should extend to 21 days for enterprise leads/qualified registrants?
- You mentioned sponsor seats — we can create a separate sponsor passcode batch with different redemption rules. If yes, please confirm the sponsor contact list/email column so we can gate them.

If you confirm by EOD Tuesday we’ll provision the codes and generate redemption tracking in HubSpot. We can also enforce SSO for any brightfoundry.com emails if you prefer.

Attachments: affiliates-passcodes-v2.csv (CSV)

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Partnerships | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0191

From: Maya Singh <maya@brightfoundry.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Tran <kevin@brightfoundry.com>, devops@brightfoundry.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access Passcodes & short trial extension for BrightFoundry roundtable

Thanks Hannah —

This looks good. A few requests from our side:

1) For enterprise leads (we flag those in our CRM), could we get a 21-day trial instead of 14? That gives our product team time to engage.
2) Please produce two separate CSVs: one for public affiliates (50 codes) and one for sponsors (10 codes). Sponsor codes should allow multiple redemptions by the sponsor team for demo accounts (we can provide a sponsor admin email).
3) Can you enforce SSO for any code redeemed by an @brightfoundry.com email? We want to limit misuse.

Also: are there per-account redemption limits we should be aware of? We don’t want a single user to claim multiple affiliate codes.

Quoted: "We can provide a bulk batch of 50 on-demand access passcodes for affiliate registrants..."

—Maya
Maya Singh
Partnerships Lead, BrightFoundry
maya@brightfoundry.com

Looping ops/legal so we can finalize. Suggested approach:

- Approve 21-day trial for any record flagged as an "enterprise lead" (Marissa will attach the list of identifying emails/HubSpot property).
- Create two CSV outputs: affiliates (50 single-use codes) and sponsors (10 codes with sponsor-admin reuse allowed). I'll attach the two files once Logan confirms billing note.
- Enforce single redemption per user for affiliate batch (we'll set a one-code-per-email rule) and one-time-per-account for sponsor batch but allow sponsor-admin to provision demo accounts via our support flow.
- SSO enforcement: Hannah, confirm you want SSO enforced for any brightfoundry.com redemptions — ops can restrict by domain if so.

Attachments (for ops): roundtable-sponsor-passcodes.csv (stub), roundtable-affiliate-passcodes-v2.csv (stub), extension-approval-thread.pdf (summary & legal note)

Laura @ops — can you provision both batches, set expiry to 60 days from provisioning, and add HubSpot tracking fields (code, redeemer email, redemption date, sponsor flag)?

Thanks —
Marissa

marissa_cole@redwood.com

All set — provisioning complete. Summary of changes and links below:

- Two batches uploaded to the partner passcodes bucket and CSVs saved to Drive: affiliates (50 single-use codes) and sponsors (10 admin-redeemable codes). Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBEXAMPLEdrive
- Expiry: codes expire 60 days from provision (2037-07-30T23:59:59Z).
- Trial length: enterprise-flagged redemptions auto-grant 21-day trial; others get 14 days.
- Redemption rules: affiliates = 1-code-per-email enforced; sponsor batch = admin reuse allowed (sponsor-admin email whitelisted).
- SSO enforcement: enabled for any brightfoundry.com redemption (domain check enforced at redemption time).
- HubSpot: created property "promo_code" and linked redemption webhook to BD-4821. I uploaded a sample redemption report (extension-approval-thread.pdf) to the Drive folder.

Next steps: Hannah, share the Drive link with Maya and confirm sponsor admin contact so we can add them to the whitelist. Logan — please add a partner billing note for the sponsor mini-batch (10 codes) under BD-4821.

Laura Bennett
